AdaptiveCardNotificationTemplate.name: Work Item Assignment Adaptive Card
AdaptiveCardNotificationTemplate.Description: Adaptive Card Notification Template for notifying work item assignee that they have been assigned a work item.

AdaptiveCardNotificationTemplate.name: Work Item Assignment Removal Adaptive Card
AdaptiveCardNotificationTemplate.Description: Adaptive Card Notification Template for notifying work item assignee that a workitem has been removed from their queue.

AdaptiveCardNotificationTemplate.name: Work Item Forward Adaptive Card
AdaptiveCardNotificationTemplate.Description: Adaptive Card Notification Template for notifying the requester/new owner of a work item that it has been forwarded.

AdaptiveCardNotificationTemplate.name: LCM Identity Update Approval Adaptive Card
AdaptiveCardNotificationTemplate.Description: Adaptive Card Notification Template for notifying approvers when they need to approve a request made through LCM. Note that in addition to the declared arguments, all workflow variables, Step arguments, and Approval arguments defined in the Workflow are also available.
